film.title: CLAUDE.MD for 50-Year-Old Coal Miners... Explained
film.description:
Hardwood Bricks Educational Series, Lesson One: Three Matthews and a Text File. A special edition of MIDnight Weave.

Three Matthews at the Bricks desk. On the left, Hat, the expert in the McGovern '72 cap. In the middle, the real Matthew, who somehow built a 27-edition basketball network with Claude and only just learned M.D. isn't Maryland. On the right, Shift Two, a coal miner with a canary, who wants to know if the computer is sick.

The lesson: every new Claude session starts fresh. It doesn't remember yesterday. So you write your rules in a plain text markdown file. Claude Code reads one called CLAUDE.md at the start of every session, and this project keeps a MEMORY.md index with one small file per subject. It remembers what's written down, so keep it current, keep it short, put the big stuff up top, and never put a password in it.

Write it down, or it didn't happen.

A Hardwood Bricks Productions show, in association with JuiceboxNationTV Entertainment. A 19 North Films production. Hat and Shift Two are HeyGen AI avatars of Matthew; the one in the middle is the real thing. Original music.

Keep it mid. Keep it real. See more at https://hardwoodbricks.com

reels.title: Is the computer sick? (What's an .MD file)
reels.text: A coal miner hears the computer has an M.D. The expert says it's markdown. The guy who built the whole network thought it was Maryland until last week.

reels.title: I accidentally built a mine
reels.text: Claude writes your rules into a memory file, one small file per subject, with an index on top. You don't carry the mountain. You carry the map.
